answer_text:
Let

\[
f(x)=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \binom{2n}{n}x^n.
\]

The standard generating function for the central binomial coefficients is

\[
f(x)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-4x}}, \qquad |x|<\frac14.
\]

Differentiate:

\[
f'(x)=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n\binom{2n}{n}x^{n-1}
=2(1-4x)^{-3/2}.
\]

Multiplying by \(x\),

\[
\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n\binom{2n}{n}x^n
=2x(1-4x)^{-3/2}.
\]

The given sum is

\[
\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\frac{2n}{8^n}\binom{2n}{n}
=2\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} n\binom{2n}{n}\left(\frac18\right)^n.
\]

Thus, at \(x=\frac18\),

\[
S=2\left[2x(1-4x)^{-3/2}\right]_{x=1/8}
=4x(1-4x)^{-3/2}\bigg|_{x=1/8}.
\]

Now

\[
4\left(\frac18\right)=\frac12,
\qquad
1-4\left(\frac18\right)=\frac12,
\]

so

\[
S=\frac12\left(\frac12\right)^{-3/2}
=\frac12\cdot 2^{3/2}
=\sqrt{2}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\sqrt{2}}
\]
